page.title: Messages
page.description: Send server event notifications by SMS to one or more phone numbers.

provider.title: SMS provider
provider.description: Choose how messages leave the panel. Twilio works worldwide; a custom HTTP gateway fits local Egyptian SMS providers.
provider.enabledHint: When off, no event messages are sent. Test messages still work so you can verify the setup.
provider.senderNameHint: Shown in message text and used as the sender ID where your provider supports it.
provider.fromHint: A Twilio phone number in +country format, or a registered 11-character alphanumeric sender ID.
provider.authTokenStored: A secret is already stored. Leave blank to keep it.
provider.httpUrlHint: Placeholders {to}, {message}, {sender} and {key} are URL-encoded before sending. {to} and {message} are required.

test.title: Test message
test.description: Edit the text below and send it to one number or every enabled number to verify the provider.
test.messagePlaceholder: Type the message you want to receive

recipients.title: Phone numbers
recipients.description: Every enabled number receives each enabled event notification.
recipients.hint: Egyptian mobiles can be entered as 01xxxxxxxxx; they are stored in international format (+20...). Other countries need a + prefix.
recipients.empty: No phone numbers yet. Add one to start receiving notifications.
recipients.label: Label

events.title: Event notifications
events.description: These are the same events as the Discord bot's notifications. Each one is sent as a plain-text SMS.

errors.noPermission: You need the Integrations permission to change SMS settings.
errors.test: Could not send the test SMS.
